gcp.compute.restrict_internet_ingress.remediation: Restrict source ranges and service ports; review target tags, service accounts and higher-priority firewall policies.
gcp.compute.restrict_internet_ingress.rationale: For a GCP VPC firewall rule, this evaluator flags FAIL when an enabled ingress firewall allow rule has a public source range and no source tag or service-account selector. Unsolicited internet traffic can reach every matching firewall target.
gcp.compute.restrict_internet_ingress.description: For a GCP VPC firewall rule, this evaluator flags FAIL when an enabled ingress firewall allow rule has a public source range and no source tag or service-account selector. Unsolicited internet traffic can reach every matching firewall target.
gcp.compute.restrict_internet_ingress.pass_when: PASS when the collected facts do not satisfy this condition: an enabled ingress firewall allow rule has a public source range and no source tag or service-account selector.
gcp.compute.restrict_internet_ingress.fail_when: FAIL when an enabled ingress firewall allow rule has a public source range and no source tag or service-account selector.
gcp.compute.restrict_internet_ingress.not_applicable_when: Firewall rule is disabled, not ingress, or declares denied rules.

azure.iam.no_full_custom_role.remediation: Replace a literal wildcard in the flagged custom Azure RBAC role with owner-reviewed Actions or DataActions required by its assigned principals.

remediation_details.summary: Replace a literal wildcard in the flagged custom Azure RBAC role with owner-reviewed Actions or DataActions required by its assigned principals.
steps: Inspect properties.type=CustomRole and every properties.permissions[] block of the exact role. This native check fails if at least one literal * appears in actions or dataActions and none of those wildcard blocks has notActions/notDataActions exclusions; any such exclusion makes the whole evaluation MANUAL, even if another block still contains an unrestricted wildcard.

Inventory assignments and each principal workload, then have the RBAC owner select the minimum supported control-plane Actions and data-plane DataActions. Draft a complete role JSON retaining the same role ID, assignableScopes and unrelated reviewed permission blocks while replacing the broad grant.

Apply the reviewed role definition, validate every dependent principal, re-read permissions and recollect. Separately review excluded and patterned grants, because an exclusion is not a deny and this predicate does not prove least privilege.

cli.label: Read the exact custom role definition
Apply the owner-reviewed full custom role definition

caveats: Updating a custom role affects all current assignments and can remove required control-plane or data-plane access. Stage workload tests and a rollback, and obtain owner review of the complete definition.
Do not treat notActions or notDataActions as explicit denies; they only subtract operations from that role grant and may not restrict permissions granted through other roles.
The scan does not identify which permissions are needed. Do not add or substitute new privileged Actions to make the check pass.

azure.iam.no_full_custom_role.rationale: For a custom Azure role, FAIL is reported when any permission block grants `*` in actions or dataActions without effective exclusions. The role can confer subscription wide administration.
